title.en: Selection right exactly where what matters is read
title.zh: 择恰在要紧者由象读出处为对

statement.en: What matters goes alike across a map's lumping exactly where it is read off the map, so some selection through the map selects exactly what matters exactly where the map reads it.
statement.zh: 要紧者跨象之归并一致，恰当它由象读出；所以经象之某择恰选出要紧者，恰在象读出它之处。

laws.en: What matters goes alike across the alternatives a map lumps together exactly where it is read off the map, through what holds of some alternative the map gives that entry.
laws.zh: 要紧者在象所归并之选项上一致，恰当它由象读出，经象给某一项之某选项所成立者。

laws.en: A selection through a map selecting exactly what matters exists exactly where what matters is read off the map.
laws.zh: 经象而恰选出要紧者之择存在，恰当要紧者由象读出。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; any types of alternatives and entries.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；选项与项之任意类型。

correspondence.en: Measurability: a function factors through a map exactly where it is constant on its fibres.
correspondence.zh: 可测性：一函数经一映射分解恰当它在其纤维上为常值。
